```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)

rel <- read_csv(
  "../data/derived/bewell_taxonomy_relAbun.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    RelAbun = as.numeric(RelAbun)
  )

ipaq <- read.csv("../data/derived/09-10-21_demographics.csv")

BEWELL_demographics <- read_csv("../data/derived/BEWELL demographics.csv")
```

### 6-taxa representative boxplots
```{r}
# Prep
rel2 <- rel %>%
  mutate(
    term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy),
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"),
      labels = c("Pre Placebo", "Post Placebo", "Pre BRB", "Post BRB")
    ),
    pretty_taxon = gsub("_", " ", gsub("^\\w__", "", term)))

# 6 taxa
top_taxa <- c(
  "s__Blautia_obeum",
  "s__Eubacterium_eligens",
  "s__Lachnospira_pectinoschiza",
  "s__Eubacterium_rectale",
  "g__Lachnospiraceae_unclassified",
  "s__Parabacteroides_goldsteinii"
)

box_df <- rel2 %>% filter(term %in% top_taxa)

p_box <- ggplot(box_df, aes(x = variable, y = RelAbun, fill = variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ pretty_taxon, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance", fill = "") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_box
ggsave("../figures/fig4_Representative_boxplots.svg", p_box, height = 8, width = 14)


```

### Baseline PCA colored by BRB effect group
```{r}
# Load model results and define BRB-enriched taxa (unadjusted p < 0.05)
load("../data/model_stats_BW.rda")  # creates model_res_BW

sig_taxa <- model_res_BW %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(term) %>%
  unique()

# Combined abundance per subject for those taxa (BRB arm only rB/tB)
rel_sig <- rel %>%
  mutate(term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy)) %>%
  filter(term %in% sig_taxa, variable %in% c("rB", "tB"))

combined_sig <- rel_sig %>%
  group_by(Subject.Number, variable) %>%
  summarise(total_abun = sum(RelAbun, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Define BRB effect group (>2-fold increase)
combined_wide <- combined_sig %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = total_abun) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rB) & !is.na(tB)) %>%
  mutate(
    fold_change = (tB + 1e-6) / (rB + 1e-6),
    brb_status  = if_else(fold_change >= 2, "altered by BRB", "not altered by BRB"),
    brb_status  = factor(brb_status, levels = c("not altered by BRB", "altered by BRB"))
  )

# Baseline (rB) abundance table (ALL taxa) for PCA
baseline_brb <- rel %>%
  mutate(term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy)) %>%
  filter(variable == "rB") %>%
  semi_join(combined_wide %>% select(Subject.Number), by = "Subject.Number") %>%
  select(Subject.Number, term, RelAbun) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = RelAbun, values_fill = 0) %>%
  left_join(combined_wide %>% select(Subject.Number, brb_status), by = "Subject.Number") %>%
  filter(!is.na(brb_status))

# PCA
X <- baseline_brb %>% select(-Subject.Number, -brb_status) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(X) <- baseline_brb$Subject.Number
pca_res <- prcomp(X, scale. = TRUE)

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  setNames(c("PC1", "PC2")) %>%
  mutate(brb_status = baseline_brb$brb_status)

# PERMANOVA p-value (Bray-Curtis on original abundances)
otu_baseline  <- baseline_brb %>% select(-Subject.Number, -brb_status)
meta_baseline <- baseline_brb %>% select(brb_status)
dist_baseline <- vegdist(otu_baseline, method = "bray")
adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_baseline ~ brb_status, data = meta_baseline)
adonis_p <- signif(adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1], 2)

# Plot with hulls (narrow polygons)
hulls <- scores %>%
  mutate(brb_status = baseline_brb$brb_status) %>%
  group_by(brb_status) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  slice(chull(PC1, PC2)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_pca <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = brb_status)) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = hulls,
    aes(PC1, PC2, fill = brb_status),
    alpha = 0.20,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
    label = paste0("p = ", adonis_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(color = "BRB effect group", fill = "BRB effect group")

p_pca
ggsave("../figures/Baseline_PCA_BRB_effect_group.svg", p_pca, width = 6, height = 4)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CLEAN ADONIS ANALYSIS
# Post-BRB microbiome ~ physical activity + baseline PCA PC1
# ============================================================

# Read fresh copies of the data
rel_adonis_pca <- read_csv(
  "../data/derived/bewell_taxonomy_relAbun.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    RelAbun = as.numeric(RelAbun),
    term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy)
  )

demo_adonis_pca <- read.csv(
  "../data/derived/09-10-21_demographics.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# Normalize subject ID column
if ("subject_number" %in% names(demo_adonis_pca)) {
  demo_adonis_pca <- demo_adonis_pca %>%
    mutate(Subject.Number = as.character(subject_number))
} else {
  demo_adonis_pca <- demo_adonis_pca %>%
    mutate(Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number))
}

activity_adonis_pca <- demo_adonis_pca %>%
  mutate(
    Activity_adonis = case_when(
      IPAQscore == "HEPA active" ~ "Active",
      METmins >= 5000 ~ "Active",
      !is.na(IPAQscore) | !is.na(METmins) ~ "Inactive",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Subject.Number,
    Activity_adonis
  ) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
paired_brb_ids_pca <- rel_adonis_pca %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  distinct(Subject.Number, variable) %>%
  count(Subject.Number, name = "n_timepoints") %>%
  filter(n_timepoints == 2) %>%
  pull(Subject.Number)

length(paired_brb_ids_pca)
```

```{r}
baseline_pca_df <- rel_adonis_pca %>%
  filter(
    variable == "rB",
    Subject.Number %in% paired_brb_ids_pca
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Subject.Number,
    term
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    RelAbun = sum(RelAbun, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = RelAbun,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Subject.Number)
```

```{r}
baseline_pca_mat <- baseline_pca_df %>%
  select(-Subject.Number) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(baseline_pca_mat) <- baseline_pca_df$Subject.Number

# Remove zero-variance taxa before scaling
baseline_pca_mat <- baseline_pca_mat[
  ,
  apply(baseline_pca_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]

baseline_pca_fit <- prcomp(
  baseline_pca_mat,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

baseline_pc_scores <- as.data.frame(
  baseline_pca_fit$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Subject.Number") %>%
  transmute(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    Pre_PC1_adonis = PC1,
    Pre_PC2_adonis = PC2
  )
```

```{r}
post_brb_adonis_df <- rel_adonis_pca %>%
  filter(
    variable == "tB",
    Subject.Number %in% paired_brb_ids_pca
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Subject.Number,
    term
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    RelAbun = sum(RelAbun, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = RelAbun,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r}
adonis_meta_pca <- post_brb_adonis_df %>%
  select(Subject.Number) %>%
  inner_join(
    baseline_pc_scores,
    by = "Subject.Number"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    activity_adonis_pca,
    by = "Subject.Number"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pre_PC1_adonis),
    !is.na(Activity_adonis)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Subject.Number, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
nrow(adonis_meta_pca)

table(adonis_meta_pca$Activity_adonis)

anyDuplicated(adonis_meta_pca$Subject.Number)
```

```{r}
post_brb_adonis_mat <- post_brb_adonis_df %>%
  filter(
    Subject.Number %in% adonis_meta_pca$Subject.Number
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(
      Subject.Number,
      adonis_meta_pca$Subject.Number
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Subject.Number) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(post_brb_adonis_mat) <-
  adonis_meta_pca$Subject.Number

# Remove taxa absent from everyone
post_brb_adonis_mat <- post_brb_adonis_mat[
  ,
  colSums(post_brb_adonis_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]

identical(
  rownames(post_brb_adonis_mat),
  adonis_meta_pca$Subject.Number
)
```
```{r}
post_bray_adonis_pca <- vegdist(
  post_brb_adonis_mat,
  method = "bray"
)
```

```{r}
)
```

#-------new panel
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

normalize_subject_id <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_extract("[0-9]+$") %>%
    as.integer() %>%
    as.character()
}
```

```{r}

smoking_clean <- BEWELL_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = normalize_subject_id(`Subject ID`)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Subject.Number,
    Smoking = `Smoking status`
  )
```

```{r}
hei_clean <- bewelldietscore_07122022 %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = normalize_subject_id(Username)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Subject.Number,
    HEI2015
  )
```

```{r}

hei_clean %>%
  count(Subject.Number) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}

    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    smoking_clean,
    by = "Subject.Number"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hei_clean,
    by = "Subject.Number"
  )
```

# ADONIS summary panel: Activity, HEI, Smoking
# Each variable is tested after accounting for baseline PCA PC1
```{r}
adonis_panel_df <- tibble(
  Variable = c(
    "Physical activity",
    "HEI-2015",
    "Smoking status"
  ),

  R2 = c(
    adonis_pc1_activity_pca["Activity_adonis", "R2"],
    adonis_hei_adjusted["HEI2015", "R2"],
    adonis_smoking_adjusted["Smoking", "R2"]
  ),

  P_value = c(
    adonis_pc1_activity_pca["Activity_adonis", "Pr(>F)"],
    adonis_hei_adjusted["HEI2015", "Pr(>F)"],
    adonis_smoking_adjusted["Smoking", "Pr(>F)"]
  ),

  n = c(
    nrow(adonis_meta_pca),
    nrow(adonis_meta_hei),
    nrow(adonis_meta_smoking)
  )
)

adonis_panel_df
```
```{r}
adonis_panel_df <- adonis_panel_df %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(
      Variable,
      levels = rev(c(
        "Physical activity",
        "HEI-2015",
        "Smoking status"
      ))
    ),

    result_label = paste0(
      "P = ", sprintf("%.3f", P_value),
      ", n = ", n
    )
  )
```

```{r}
p_adonis_panel <- ggplot(
  adonis_panel_df,
  aes(
    x = R2,
    y = Variable
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = R2,
      yend = Variable
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = result_label
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.004,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.40))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Marginal " * R^2),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_adonis_panel
```

```{r}
        ", P = ", sprintf("%.3f", P_value),
        ", n = ", n
      )
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.004,
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.75))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(R^2),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_adonis_panel2

ggsave(
  "../figures/ADONIS_univariate_main.svg",
  plot = p_adonis_panel2,
  width = 6,
  height = 4
)
```
